item.title: Ask HN: How are you finding the job market in 2026?
item.summary: Monitoring the past few months of HN whoishiring threads - seems there's more seekers than firms hiring. on LinkedIn - seems a bunch of jobs get rotated (reposted) - or are just spam. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49279790 Points: 4 # Comments: 2
